# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| training-package | `assets/training-package.md`, filled | Plant owner, trainer role | One plant, one solution, one rollout moment; Plant roles named (roles only); Modules chosen with a hands-on form on the real screen, machine or shift; Durations, dates and trainers marked `⟨…⟩` unless a source gives them; Readiness stated |
| competence-checklist | `assets/competence-checklist.md`, filled | `deploy-handover` | Each competence confirmed by the plant owner with evidence; No critical skill rests on one person |
| readiness-statement | Readiness section of the package | Plant owner | Acceptance passed, data path written down to the machine, sign-off gate answered, plant infrastructure live; Otherwise stated as not ready and no training scheduled |
| gap-report | Open competences and single-person skills listed | OD lead via COP | Every competence that cannot be confirmed, or skill held by one person, is reported upward |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| training-package | structure of `assets/training-package.md` | Plant owner |
| competence-checklist | structure of `assets/competence-checklist.md` | OD lead |
| readiness-statement | manual | Plant owner |
| gap-report | manual | OD lead via COP |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `deploy-acceptance`, `deploy-handover`, `deploy-cybersec`
- **Next:** deploy-handover (the completed checklist is its input for the Knowledge and Ability elements; used on steps 1a3, 1b4, 26 and 3a6), then the Scorecard utilization rate for Reinforcement.: `deploy-handover`
- **Stops here when:** the solution is not accepted yet, the plant infrastructure is not live (no training on a demo environment), or only one plant person can do a critical task
- **Stops here when:** Training may cover the Cyber Security gate while sign-off is open, with no live connection exercise
